images.tooltip.add_reference_images_1c9f: Choose up to 10 PNG, JPEG, or WebP files to guide the image render. Each must be under 10 MiB and all together under 40 MiB.
images.tooltip.advanced_custom_sampling_: Expert. A comma-separated list of falling sigmas from 1 down, for example 1, 0.8, 0.5, 0.2. Their count replaces Sampling steps. Blank uses the model’s own schedule.
images.tooltip.advanced_kv_cache_61acaa: Reuses the prompt and reference computations on every step, which speeds up edits with references. Turn it off only to compare: the same seed then gives a different but equally valid image.
images.tooltip.advanced_settings_1eb415: Open the optional seed control for this image render.
images.tooltip.aspect_ratio_3081a8: Choose the image shape. This sets the default dimensions; you can override width and height below.
images.tooltip.balanced_c0cc60: Uses 30 image-generation steps, a middle ground between speed and detail.
images.tooltip.describe_what_you_want_to: Describe the subject, visual style, lighting, and mood. This text guides the image render.
images.tooltip.draft_89eb71: Uses 12 image-generation steps for a quicker render.
images.tooltip.fine_tune_image_d31ce0: Set exact dimensions, steps and seed, ask for a transparent background, match a reference image’s shape, or describe details to avoid.
images.tooltip.height_in_pixels_33ee40: Set the output height from 32 to 2752 pixels. Leave blank to use the selected aspect ratio; values must be multiples of 32. Sizes above about 2 megapixels need far more GPU memory.
images.tooltip.high_quality_361987: Uses 40 image-generation steps for more refinement, with a longer render time.
images.tooltip.landscape_16_9_b45ced: Uses a wide 1024 × 576 image by default.
images.tooltip.lora_938981: Apply a LoRA (a small add-on file that adds a style or subject) to this render only. Choose from the .safetensors files in models/Qwen-Image-2.1-LoRA. It must be made for Qwen Image 2.1 and needs the peft package in the image app.
images.tooltip.lora_strength_667841: How strongly the LoRA is applied, from 0 to 2. Blank uses 1; lower blends it in more gently.
images.tooltip.match_the_last_reference_: Sizes the render to about one megapixel with the same aspect ratio as the last reference image, instead of the width and height below. Useful for edits. Needs a reference image.
images.tooltip.negative_prompt_32377b: Describe elements you want the image to avoid. This is optional and only takes effect when negative prompt guidance is enabled.
images.tooltip.negative_prompt_guidance_: Controls how strongly the render avoids your negative prompt. Must be greater than 1 and at most 10; higher values can increase render time. Blank uses 2.
images.tooltip.portrait_9_16_b544e2: Uses a tall 576 × 1024 image by default.
images.tooltip.project_7b5fea: Choose the project where this image and its render will be saved.
images.tooltip.quality_cb7fbe: Sets the number of image-generation steps: Draft uses 12, Balanced uses 30, and High quality uses 40. More steps usually take longer.
images.tooltip.reference_images_4c1737: Optional visual references for the render. Add up to 10 PNG, JPEG, or WebP files; each must be under 10 MiB and together under 40 MiB. Select them again after refreshing the page.
images.tooltip.reference_size_target_73d: With “Match the last reference’s shape”, the render is sized to about this side length squared while keeping the reference’s aspect ratio. Blank uses 1024. Larger needs much more GPU memory.
images.tooltip.sampling_steps_40d9b3: Choose 1–100 generation steps. More steps can improve refinement but take longer; blank uses the selected quality setting.
images.tooltip.seed_d07208: Enter a whole number to repeat a render: the same prompt, references and settings with the same seed gave an identical image in tests. Leave blank for a random seed, which Forge records with the image.
images.tooltip.transparent_background_be: Asks Qwen for a PNG with a transparent background, for sprites, icons and stickers. Forge adds Qwen’s recommended wording to your prompt; only your own text is saved. Works best with one clear subject.
images.tooltip.variations_7be51e: Queue 2 to 4 renders at once with the same settings and different seeds, so you can compare. Each is a separate render in the queue, labelled “variation 1 of N”. The model itself makes one image per render.
images.tooltip.width_in_pixels_b88e16: Set the output width from 32 to 2752 pixels. Leave blank to use the selected aspect ratio; values must be multiples of 32. Sizes above about 2 megapixels need far more GPU memory.
